text.formatted: When you take the Hide action, you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check in an attempt to hide, following the rules for hiding. If you succeed, you gain certain benefits, as described in the "Unseen Attackers and Targets" section.
text.plain: When you take the Hide action, you make a Dexterity (Stealth) check in an attempt to hide, following the rules for hiding. If you succeed, you gain certain benefits, as described in the "Unseen Attackers and Targets" section.

prose.text: Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check to hide; see Unseen Attackers and Targets.

gap.name: 2014 hiding: Stealth against each observer, with no condition
